notes.title: Game releasing on 18th Sept, 2020.
notes.notes:
Hi All,

The wait is over now!!!
Our game is finally launching on 18th Sept, 2020.
We would also like to inform you that soundtrack is included with the game copy but will only be available after on 25th Sept, 2020.
You don't need to pay additionally for that.
Thanks for all your support and love. :)

notes.title: Apologies for Delaying Game
notes.notes:
Hi Gamer,

Due to the current ongoing pandemic, our game is going to be delayed.
Game is still in development process and will take some more time before ready to be launched.
The final date is not confirmed yet. Once we are sure about the release date we will make another announcement.
We apologize for the inconvenience. 

Thanks
Dev Team...
